situation (example wording): "share of murders committed with a firearm per year since 2000", "percent of murders by strangers each year"
what the app does today: Declined or asked: these shares are not built.
proposed behavior: A share asked for over several years ("per year", "each year", "since <year>" or a span) is one row per year, each year its own share over the agencies that filed that year, never pooled into one share (the rule of P203); no period named is every year the source has (P181). Each row gives the year, the count of the thing, the murders it divides and the share; the coverage lines are as today. Applies to P210 to P213 and to P165.
exact default or choices offered: A table Year | count | murders | share, one row per year.
why: Same rule Jeff gave for the clearance share (several years, a row per year).
